description: rit.run helps connected users review their running activity, heart-rate and pace summaries, running shoes, and active weekly training plan for fitness coaching. Users can compare rit.run runner, shoe, and anonymous route rankings, open privacy-trimmed Google Maps links, request changes to eligible future plan days, and submit training-method or product feedback to rit.run.
